comment: “Legacy systems are not the enemy of DPI-H, unplanned legacy systems are” is memorable but imprecise. Many legacy systems were planned appropriately for earlier requirements but have become unsupported or misaligned over time.

anchor.note: p.93 l.Lines 198-200 read as the printed page; section 4.2.3 agrees

public.text: “Legacy systems are not the enemy of DPI-H, unplanned legacy systems are” is memorable but imprecise. Many legacy systems were planned appropriately for earlier requirements but have become unsupported or misaligned over time.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with a sentence like: “Legacy systems should be assessed according to their current value, risk, supportability, interoperability, and strategic fit rather than their age alone.”
